mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_tag_info (tag_content, tag_subtitle, tag_cover, class_id) VALUES (#{param.tagContent}, #{param.tagSubtitle}, #{param.tagCover}, #{param.classId})
mapper.update:
UPDATE goods_tag_info
is_active = #{param.isActive},
tag_content=#{param.tagContent},
tag_subtitle = #{param.tagSubtitle},
tag_cover = #{param.tagCover},
class_id = #{param.classId}
WHERE tag_id =#{param.tagId}
mapper.select:
SELECT gt.tag_id, gt.class_id, gt.tag_content, gt.tag_subtitle, gt.tag_cover, gt.is_active, gtc.class_name FROM goods_tag_info gt LEFT JOIN goods_tag_class_info gtc ON gt.class_id = gtc.class_id where 1=1
and tag_content=#{param.tagContent}

select ti.tag_content as tagContent, ti.tag_subtitle as tagSubtitle, ti.tag_cover as tagCover, ai.articleNum, ai.articleReadNum from goods_tag_info ti, (select count(1) as articleNum, sum(read_num) as articleReadNum from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info where tag_id = #{tagId}) as ai where ti.tag_id = #{tagId}
select tag_id, class_id, tag_content, tag_subtitle, tag_cover from goods_tag_info where class_id = #{param.classId}

SELECT distinct gt.tag_content, gt.tag_subtitle, gt.tag_cover, gt.tag_id FROM goods_tag_info gt LEFT JOIN goods_article_info ga ON gt.tag_id = ga.tag_id WHERE is_active = 1 AND audit_state = 1 ORDER BY ga.tag_id desc limit #{param.limit}
